_comment: A23 (§13.5). The mutation half of the gate: 'a suite that kills mutants is the only proof the tests are real'. Scope mirrors vitest.config.ts's coverage `include`/`exclude` exactly, so the two halves of the gate measure the same files.
_ignoreComment: src/lib/storage/db.test.ts is excluded because it cannot run here, not because it is unwanted: 5 of its 7 tests set process.env.TZ at runtime, which only moves the clock under vitest's default `forks` pool. Stryker's vitest runner hard-codes `pool: threads, maxWorkers: 1` for vitest >= 4.1.0, where process.env.TZ is inert, so those tests fail the dry run and no score can be produced at all. Consequence: src/lib/storage/db.ts's nowIso offset arithmetic is measured without its own test and its survivors are NOT gaps. Delete this entry the moment db.test.ts stops depending on the pool. See ledger A23-c.
